cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Pay the climbing-course deposit before we discuss the cliff.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. It's refundable only if we attend the first lesson.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So paying makes not climbing harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A small commitment can do the worrying for us.
